note: Read by server/tests/test_description_labels.py and by web/src/lib/description-labels.test.ts. The rule lives in two languages because the editor has to paint exactly what the server drops; this file is what keeps them the same rule.

cases.why: a plain description is untouched

cases.why: a leading zero is still a number
full-width digits and a full-width stop
an ideographic space is how a numbered line is written in Japanese
a closing parenthesis is a numbering too
a colon as well
a year is description, not a number label
a count is description: no separator follows the digit
a half-width space alone does not make a digit a label
a bracketed source is a comment
